meta.note: Each key opens its numbered deposit box; key stays in inventory but is permanently removed from spawn pool (added to used_vault_keys carry-over).

meta.notes: Tomb: near candles grant upgrade_disk_tomb + 4 dice; far candles reveal Diary Key — both pairs modeled as one ignition event granting all three (simplification: two-step reveal collapsed to one). Diary Key is a REWARD of lighting the Tomb, not a prerequisite. Chapel: lighting the altar grants accumulated Keeper of Tithes coins (chapel_tithes counter, incremented each time the entry -1 coin penalty actually fires); the payout is resolved in engine/special_items.py light(). Trading Post fuse grants (Upgrade Disk + 40 coins) are wiki-documented; the secret room is collapsed to an immediate grant since it is not modeled. Freezer thaw is temporary/daily and not modeled. absent_targets lists rooms the wiki mentions but that are absent from rooms.json. requires_item is supported by the engine but no target uses it (the Diary Key is a reward of the Tomb, not a prerequisite).

greenhouse.notes: Installing the lever unlocks the Antechamber's south doorway segment (between rank-8 center cell 37 and Antechamber cell 42) for free, enabling walk-through without a key. The north door opens only from the Throne Room and the Sanctum lever (neither modeled).

The Antechamber's south door and cell-37's north door are the same segment: segment_key(42,S)==segment_key(37,N)==(37,1). The north door opens only from the Throne Room and the Sanctum lever (neither modeled).
